# CANDIDATE: V14V15_PARAM_SWEEP_TOP_KEEPER

## Hypothesis

We are trying to capture more profit on the 5/04 winner day by adjusting exit parameters: tightening the SUPER take-profit to 75% (super_tp1=0.75) to bank profits earlier while setting a runner target of 3.0 (runner_target=3.0) to let winners run further. Simultaneously, we tighten stops across all quality tiers (super_stop=-0.15, level_stop=-0.12, trendline_stop=-0.06) to reduce losses on loser days. The hypothesis is that these changes will improve edge_capture by increasing winner P&L and decreasing loser P&L.

## Mechanism

The combo modifies exit parameters for different setup qualities:
- SUPER setups: stop at -15%, TP1 at 75%
- LEVEL setups: quantity=18, stop at -12%, TP1 at 30%
- TRENDLINE setups: stop at -6%
Entries are triggered by the existing v14/v15 logic (unchanged). Exits use the chart stop as primary invalidation, with the above parameters as secondary stops/profit targets. The chandelier profit-lock and time stop (15:50 ET) remain as per v15.
